newsitem.title: USA: Conceptus adopts shareholder rights plan.
newsitem.headline: Conceptus adopts shareholder rights plan.

text.p: Conceptus Inc Friday said its board adopted a stockholder rights plan.
Conceptus said it was not aware of any proposed acquisition but was responding to increased levels of acquisition activity in the healthcare industry.

The company said the rights will initially trade with shares of the company's common stock and have no impact on the way in which its shares are traded. The distribution of the rights will be payable to stockholders of record on March 26, 1997. The rights will expire on Feb. 26, 2007.

The rights are not exercisable until 10 days after a person or group announces acquisition of 20 percent or more of Conceptus's outstanding common stock or the commencement of a tender offer which would result in ownership by the person or group of 20 percent or more of the outstanding common stock. Each right will entitle stockholders to buy one one-thousandth of a share of the company's Series A Participating Preferred Stock at an exercise price of $80.00.

The company will be entitled to redeem the rights at $0.01 per right at any time on or before the tenth day following an acquisition by a person or group of 20 percent or more of the company's common stock.
